Title: Verify save game auto-recovery after sudden power loss or process kill
Preconditions: Player has initiated Chapter 02 and reached auto-save checkpoint 'Catacombs_Entrance'.
Steps:
1. Trigger an in-game autosave checkpoint icon.
2. Abruptly kill the application process (kill -9 or power plug pull) during active disk write.
3. Relaunch the application.
4. Select 'Continue' from Main Menu.
Expected Result: Game detects incomplete save, falls back to the previous intact checkpoint without crashing or corrupting user save profile.

Title: Verify system pause and controller disconnect prompt when gamepad battery dies
Preconditions: Game is running in active gameplay (combat state). DualSense controller connected.
Steps:
1. Enter combat encounter in Level 04.
2. Disconnect gamepad (turn off controller or disconnect USB cable).
3. Observe screen behavior and game audio.
Expected Result: Gameplay immediately pauses. Official platform modal 'Please reconnect controller' is rendered. Audio volume ducks to ambient level.

Title: Verify seamless docked to handheld mode transition without asset reload
Preconditions: Nintendo Switch 2 in Docked TV Mode at 1440p resolution.
Steps:
1. Run active gameplay in open-world area.
2. Undock the console to Handheld Mode.
3. Observe transition time, HUD scaling, and frame stability.
Expected Result: Screen seamlessly scales to 1080p handheld profile within < 1.0 second. No UI clipping, no asset reload stutter, touch input activates.

Title: Verify HUD scaling and anchor integrity on 32:9 Super Ultrawide resolution
Preconditions: PC build running on Samsung Odyssey G9 (5120x1440 32:9).
Steps:
1. Set display resolution to 5120x1440 in Graphics Options.
2. Enter active gameplay.
3. Open inventory, mini-map, and quest tracker.
Expected Result: HUD elements anchor within the configurable 16:9 safe zone or correctly at viewport edges without stretching or aspect distortion.

Title: Verify 3D audio occlusion behind closed soundproof vault door
Preconditions: Player has 7.1 surround sound or spatial binaural headphones enabled.
Steps:
1. Position an active audio emitter (humming generator) inside Vault Room.
2. Stand outside Vault Room with door open and verify loud volume.
3. Close the heavy blast door.
Expected Result: Sound is muffled according to occlusion low-pass filter (>= 18dB attenuation). No audio popping or sudden phase cancellation.

Title: Verify JWT Bearer token auto-refresh on 401 Unauthorized expiration
Preconditions: User is logged in on Web Dashboard. Short-lived Access Token has expired.
Steps:
1. Trigger an authenticated API request (e.g. GET /api/v1/user/profile).
2. Intercept response returning 401 Token Expired.
3. Observe HTTP client behavior and network tab.
Expected Result: Client interceptor transparently calls POST /api/v1/auth/refresh, acquires new access token, and retries original request without user logout.

Title: Verify rate limiter responds with HTTP 429 and Retry-After header
Preconditions: Client has valid API key with 60 requests/minute tier.
Steps:
1. Send 61 rapid GET /api/v1/products requests within 10 seconds using test runner.
2. Inspect headers and status code of the 61st response.
Expected Result: Server returns HTTP 429 Too Many Requests, valid JSON error body, and 'Retry-After: 50' header.

Title: Verify search query input sanitization against SQL and NoSQL injection payloads
Steps:
1. Dispatch search queries containing ' OR 1=1; --, <script>alert(1)</script>, and {$gt: ''}.
2. Inspect HTTP response and backend database error logs.
Expected Result: Server responds with 200 OK or 400 Bad Request. All queries are treated as literal text. Zero unhandled SQL/ORM database exceptions.

Title: Verify idempotency key prevents duplicate credit card charges on double-click
Preconditions: User is on checkout step with items in shopping cart. Network throttling set to 3G.
Steps:
1. Generate unique Idempotency-Key header on checkout form.
2. Double-click the 'Pay Now' button rapidly twice.
3. Observe transactions created in payment gateway.
Expected Result: Only exactly ONE payment transaction is processed. Second request returns HTTP 200 with identical transaction ID from cache.

Title: Verify cursor-based pagination boundary behavior on empty and final page
Preconditions: Database contains exactly 25 item records. Page size configured to 10.
Steps:
1. Request GET /api/v1/items?limit=10 (Page 1 - receives 10 items + next_cursor).
2. Request Page 2 with next_cursor (receives 10 items).
3. Request Page 3 with next_cursor (receives 5 items + next_cursor=null).
4. Request beyond last cursor.
Expected Result: Final page correctly returns remaining 5 records with next_cursor null. Extra request returns empty array [] with HTTP 200 OK.

Title: Verify state preservation when switching mobile app to background during form input
Preconditions: User is filling out a multi-step verification form (Step 3 of 4).
Steps:
1. Fill in 6 input fields in verification form.
2. Press Home button / swipe to switch app to background.
3. Open Camera app, take 3 photos, then return to tested app after 60 seconds.
Expected Result: App restores state immediately without reloading form. All previously entered text and validation states remain intact.

Title: Verify offline data synchronization when network connection is restored
Preconditions: Device is placed in Airplane Mode / Offline state.
Steps:
1. Create 3 new offline task entries in the local app database.
2. Verify UI shows 'Pending Sync' badges.
3. Disable Airplane Mode to restore Wi-Fi connection.
Expected Result: Background sync worker triggers automatically, flushes queued mutations to cloud backend, and updates items to 'Synced' status.

Title: Verify frame pacing stability under dense volumetric particle emitter
Preconditions: Test scene loaded with 50,000 GPU particle sparks and heavy alpha blending.
Steps:
1. Spawn particle emitter in camera view frustum.
2. Record 1% low and 0.1% low FPS using hardware telemetry capture.
3. Move camera around emitter for 60 seconds.
Expected Result: Frame rate does not drop below 58 FPS on PS5 / XSX (Performance Mode target 60 FPS). No micro-stuttering or thermal throttling.

Title: Verify memory stability and absence of RAM leaks during 45-minute continuous play
Preconditions: Automated test loop running level transitions, menu toggles, and combat cycles.
Steps:
1. Monitor process private working set / VRAM memory footprint via telemetry profiler.
2. Run continuous test loop for 45 minutes across 10 level loads.
3. Compare baseline RAM usage at minute 5 vs minute 45.
Expected Result: Total allocated RAM growth does not exceed 150 MB (within garbage collection threshold). Zero Out-of-Memory crashes.

Title: Verify screen reader focus order and WCAG 2.2 AA accessibility on checkout dialog
Preconditions: Screen reader active (VoiceOver on macOS/iOS or NVDA on Windows).
Steps:
1. Navigate to Checkout page using Tab key navigation only.
2. Trigger the modal dialog 'Confirm Purchase'.
3. Verify accessibility focus trap, label announcements, and Escape key dismissal.
Expected Result: Focus shifts automatically to first interactive element inside dialog. Background content is inert. Screen reader announces all labels clearly.
